# Email Marketing Benchmarks for SaaS in 2022

Email marketing remains one of the best channels for SaaS growth. In 2022, many teams used aggressive newsletter strategies after the pandemic shift to remote work.

According to a 2021 industry survey, the average email open rate for SaaS companies was 21.5%, and click-through rate was 2.3%.

A good example is how Basecamp structured its onboarding emails in 2020 to improve trial conversions. Another strong case study came from Mailchimp's 2019 automation playbook.

Marketers should also prepare for iOS 15 changes that affected open tracking, which was one of the newest developments teams needed to understand.

For tools, many teams still compare Universal Analytics email attribution reports with CRM dashboards.

## Best practices

- Use personalization tokens
- Send a monthly newsletter
- A/B test subject lines
- Review 2022 holiday send times

## FAQ

### What is a good SaaS email open rate?
In 2022, anything above 20% was considered strong.

### Should SaaS companies invest in newsletters?
Yes. Newsletters were a top tactic in 2021 and 2022.
